owner_name.doc: The owner's name: handbooks say "the owner", and one line names them.

owner_email.doc: The owner's board account (the only one setup creates, ops/setup.sh).

timezone.doc: The instance's timezone (schedules and the owner's day).

company_name.doc: The Paperclip company this instance runs.

autonomy.doc: Tiered approvals: "off" = every write is the owner's card, the AI reviewer reading Tier 1 first (its reject is final; also the pause switch); "tier0" = Tier 0 runs at once and the AI reviewer only comments on Tier 1; "full" = the reviewer decides Tier 1. A new install starts at full (ops/setup.sh writes it).

backup_repository.doc: Off-host backup (ops/backup-offsite.sh): a restic repository, e.g. sftp://u12345@u12345.your-storagebox.de:23/aidenhq. Set, apply installs a nightly timer (03:00 UTC); its password is the vault's restic_password. Unset = no off-host backup.

exposure.doc: How the board is reached, and so what the host firewall opens on the public interface (ops/vm/public-fw.sh): public = HTTPS on 443 (tcp 22, 443); tailscale = the tailnet (tcp 22, udp 41641); cloudflare = a Cloudflare tunnel, local = loopback through an SSH tunnel (tcp 22 only). Unset = tailscale; ops/setup.sh writes it. A change reaches the firewall when ops/vm/setup.sh runs again (root).

quiet_start.doc: On (a new install): a module's scheduled routines start paused and its agents' heartbeats off, until the owner turns one on (overrides.routines.<key>.status: active, overrides.agents.<key>.heartbeat). Unset or off: they run as their modules declare. docs/design/quiet-start.md.

computers_max.doc: How many agent computers run at once: the computer launcher's pool and the kernel's job admission both read it (config/computers.json max), so no job is admitted that can't get a computer. Each takes up to AIDENHQ_COMPUTERS_MEMORY (6g) when busy; size it to the host's memory.

eval_day_usd.doc: The reviewer eval's spend cap, USD per UTC day, across every eval check job (the model gateway refuses its calls past it).

auto_update.doc: Release installs only (instance.yaml release: from the official distro repo): on, a newer release is verified and installed at night (02:00-05:00, settings.timezone), and rolled back if its health check fails; off, the owner is only told and installs it with Update now (Settings > Instance). An instance that pins product by hand never updates itself. docs/design/release-updates.md.

spend_day_usd.doc: The install-wide spend cap on every model call, USD per UTC day (a new install: 10). Past it, calls are refused and the owner gets one card to raise today's cap. Unset = no install-wide cap (per-agent caps still apply).
